# Authored PDF fixtures

`authored_korean.pdf` is generated by `generate_authored_korean_pdf.py` from
the original sentence below. The fixture, generator, and sentence were written
for this repository and are licensed under the same terms as the repository.
They contain no third-party document content or external font files.

> 연차 휴가는 사전에 신청합니다.

The PDF declares a Korean CID font and includes an explicit ToUnicode map so
text extraction is deterministic. The font itself is not embedded because the
fixture tests text extraction rather than visual typography.

Regenerate the fixture from the repository root with:

```powershell
.venv314/Scripts/python.exe tests/fixtures/pdfs/generate_authored_korean_pdf.py
```
